title: chylismia brevipes subsp. pallidula
intro: Chylismia brevipes subsp. pallidula, commonly known as pallid mariposa tulip, is a flowering plant species belonging to the evening primrose family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of pallid mariposa tulip include soothing and calming effects, making it a potential natural remedy for stress and anxiety relief. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds with potential medicinal properties, although further research is needed to confirm its full range of therapeutic applications.
